ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with an estimated 70:30 ratio relative to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark pigmentation covers approximately 70% of the surface area, primarily in the central and leading regions. Distal lobe sections exhibit dense, irregular white-grey mottling. High-contrast white markings appear as isolated clusters and intersecting lines against the dark matrix.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide-aperture V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 125 degrees with a shallow vertical depth relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular and jagged boundary; high-frequency serrations and deep, irregular indentations (peaks and valleys) occur across the entire span from the median notch to the distal tips, isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges demonstrate a convex sweep, while the trailing edges follow an irregular, asymmetrical path with significant jagged interruptions to the expected curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct annular (O-shaped) white pixel clusters are visible within the central dark regions of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized scarring patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of high-contrast, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions; includes prominent parallel sets (rake marks) on the distal right lobe and intersecting single lines across the medial dark zones.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and deep indentations along the trailing edge, particularly visible on the inner margin of the right lobe; overall fluke margin shows signs of extensive physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-density cross-hatching of white linear marks across the central-left and central-right dark pigmented areas.
